# NWS Money Masterclass

> Free, interactive financial-literacy course for teens and young adults.
> Learn money skills by doing: budgeting, banking, credit, scams, housing,
> insurance, and adult-life basics. No account. No cost. Works offline.

## What it is

NWS Money Masterclass (https://nws.trujoedigital.com/) is a free,
self-paced financial literacy program built for high-school and
college-age learners. Every module pairs a short lesson with interactive
practice: budget builders, scenario quizzes, and simulations with
consequences — not lectures.

## Who it's for

- Teens learning to manage their first paycheck, bank account, or budget
- Young adults facing rent, credit cards, insurance, and tax paperwork
- Teachers and youth programs needing a free financial-literacy curriculum
- Parents teaching kids about money

## Modules

- Budgeting & spending plans
- Banking (checking/savings, avoiding overdraft)
- Credit & debt (how credit cards really work)
- Scam & fraud safety
- Housing & renting costs
- Utilities & food budgeting
- Transportation costs
- Health insurance basics
- Tax paperwork (W-2, W-4)
- Adult-life skills assessments

## Key facts

- 100% free, no account or login required
- Text-to-speech in multiple languages
- Simple Mode for accessibility
- Progress saves in the browser (nothing uploaded)
- Made by TruJoe Digital, Clarksville, Arkansas

## FAQ

**Is NWS Money Masterclass really free?**
Yes. Every lesson, quiz, and simulation is free with no account.

**Do I need to create an account?**
No. Progress is saved in your own browser.

**What ages is it for?**
Built for teens and young adults (roughly 14–24), useful for any beginner.

**Does it work offline?**
Yes. It's a progressive web app — install it and use it without internet.

**Who made it?**
TruJoe Digital (https://trujoedigital.com), Clarksville, Arkansas.
